title: Momcozy Wellness 1 Wearable Breast Pump, Warm-Massage Hands-Free Pump with Heated Flange&Simulated Massage for Comfortable Breastfeeding&Let-Down, App-Controlled, 4 Modes 12 Levels, 180ml/6oz
bullets: [WARM MASSAGE FOR COMFORTABLE PUMPING]: Unlike traditional pumps with constant suction, Wellness 1 wearable breast pump features a 360° heated flange with gentle vibration massage for a soothing, comfortable pumping experience, helping ease engorgement and support natural milk flow.

[FAST WARMTH FOR EFFECTIVE EMPTYING]: Heats to your preferred temperature (99°F–106°F) in seconds. With 3 warmth levels, 3 massage levels, and 5-zone circular massage, Wellness 1 helps encourage let-down and effective milk emptying.

[GENTLE LIKE YOUR BABY’S MOUTH]: SoftPuls technology mimics a baby’s natural sucking rhythm with gentle pull-and-release motions instead of constant suction, which helps reduce nipple discomfort while supporting smooth and natural milk flow.

[APP-CONTROLLED PERSONALIZED PUMPING]: Easily customize your session via the Momcozy App with 4 modes and 12 suction levels (0–295 mmHg). Adjust warmth, massage, and suction for a fully personalized, hands-free pumping experience.

[SEE-THROUGH DESIGN – PUMP WITH CONFIDENCE]: The transparent top helps you easily align and monitor milk flow in real time, reducing spills and leaks. Quiet and discreet with a comfortable DoubleFit silicone flange, so you can pump confidently at home, work, or on the go.

[LONG BATTERY LIFE, LESS CLEANUP]: Designed for busy moms, the 2200mAh battery lasts up to 10 sessions per charge, while detachable parts and a one-press milk collector make setup and cleaning fast and hassle-free.
